content: Anmar-san-degisadeguad

Ar anmar nue-wismalad, anmar-san-we-napneggined dordonegyob gued. We-san-dordoneyobgued surgusale, gwen akarsulid. Ar Bab-Dummad anmarga neg-binidyob, san-gwapid nibneggi ukoed. We-san geg-bergued, dule-argangi-sobarsulidid, degisadeguoed-sanad.
A-ulale, anmar we-san-sedimaladgi an akigindimarsunnad. Bitigi anmar-san-nibalid, an nikudapmaloedse-nadena gadinye an binsadimarsunnad.
Adi, anmar nibneggi-megdapogua, anmar nuekwaa akwelegegar.

Amba deyob anmar-san dordonegyob-gued-an-sedimaladgi nunmakedba an akigindimalad. Ar anmarde, uka-swiri-gudii gubisulid, san-binid bur an yobimalad. Adi, san-we-napneggi-sunna-bergued, burba-duladse berguegar. Adi, dulagudigu anmar degisadeguegar.
Ar a-ular, Bab-Dummad anmar-obinnisad. Deginbali, anmarga E-Burba uksabalid, anmarga iduakwaa oyogegar, ede, nue-napira ibmar-nuegan anmarga imakoye.
A-ulale, anmar bensuli gudimarsunnad. Ar anmar wisid, amba we-sangi an gudimalale, anmar Bab-Jesús-walikasurmalad.
Ar anmar Jesús-daksurmar-inigwele, degite, Jesúsʼgi bensuli an nanadimalad.
Ar an nue-bensuli gudimalad. Agala, we-sangi an bangusmalana gadinye binsadimalad, adi, Bab-Jesús-walik an gudigumalagar.
Degisoggu, anmar bia gudidibe, we-napneggindibe, we-napnegginsurdibe, Bab-Jesús-bur-yeer-itoged an imakbimalad.

Ar ade, anmar bela Cristo-igar-itogoed-asabin gwisgumaloedbiid, adi, anmar na wala-walagwen anmar-ibmar-imaksadba ibmar-abingamalagar. Ibmar-nued-imaksadbardibe, ibmar-isgana-imaksadbardibe, ibmar anmar abingaoed.
Bab-Dummad dulemarbo-igar-naboged

Ar anmar Bab-Dummad-dobee-nanaed wismarsoggu, a-ular, anmar dulemargi alamaknaimarsunnad, adi, Jesúsʼba nagumalagar. Ar Bab-Dummad nue-anmar-wisid, anmar igi-damala. Degine, bemar nue-anmar-daed wisi-wilubmarmogad.

Anmar na dukin bemarga sogsurmalad, anmar dule-nuegan gumarye. Anmar-ibmar-imakedba, bemar anmargi yeer-itogegalad. Adi, bemar, dulemar-unnila-asginbi-ibmar-dakmalad-abinsaegar. We-dulemar, gwagegi ibmar-daksurmalad.
Ar akarguarye anmarnik-soglealile, we Bab-Dummadga anmar deyob gudido. Anmar gwen-akarguarsurye anmarnik-soglegele, adi, bemarga anmar deyobdo.
Ar Cristo-sabgued, weyob bela-bela binsae anmar-imaked: Ar Cristo bela dulemarga burgwisale, degisoggu, bela dulemar eba burgwismarmogad.
Cristo bela dulemarga burgwisad, adi, dulemar-dula-gudimalad, melle bar na ega gudigumalagar. Adi, dule-ega-burgwisadga, ega-durgusadga, dula-gudii gumalagar.
Degisoggu, a-ulale, dule-Bab-wissurmalad-binsaedyob, bar an dulemar-daksurmalad. Ar iduar dule-Bab-wissurmalad-binsaedyob, an Cristo-daksamar-inigwele, emigindi, bar deyob an Cristo-daksurmalad.
Degisoggu, dule Cristoʼgi akanonikile, dule-gwapidga gued. Ibmar-sergandi bela ega bato nasad. Emigindi, bela ibmar-biniganbi ega gued.
We-ibmar bela Bab-Dummadgi danikid. Ar Bab-Dummad na dukin anmarbo Cristoʼgi igar-naboleged imaksad. Degine, anmarga we-igar uksad, adi, dulemar Bab-Dummad-ebo igar-nabogegar.
Bab-Dummad Cristoʼgi dule-we-napneggi-bukmalad-ebo igar nabosad. Dule-e-isguedgi Bab-Dummad bar binsadasulid. Degine, Bab-Dummad dulemarbo-igar-nabogedgi-sunmakega anmarga igar uksad.
Degisoggu, anmar Cristo-nuggi-barmilealidga gumarsunnad. Bab-Dummad anmarba bemarse-wilesakwaa-gornaiyob, Cristo-nuggi anmar bemarse wilesunnad: “Bab-Dummad-ebo bemar igar nabomarsunye.”
Bab-Dummad, Cristo-anmar-isgued-seega imaksad. We-Cristo gwen isgussulid. Degite, dule-isgusadyob gunonikid, adi, Bab-Dummad, isgussuliyob Cristoʼgi anmar-dakegar.
